title: History Of Thai Literature - Including Lao, Ahom, Shan, Khamti
author: Comparative Tai Literary Studies Board
description: Comprehensive comparative monograph surveying the narrative traditions, historical chronicles, metrical poetry, and Buddhist canonical texts spanning the Tai diaspora. Highlights the linguistic unity connecting Tai Khamyang, Tai Phake, Khamti, Shan, and Lao.
